task: Add tenacity retry/backoff to ConfluenceDatasourceLoader._search_content_by_cql for transient HTTP 502/503/504 errors with config from STORAGE_CONFIG and 3 new mock-based tests.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: tenacity retry decorator applied at class-method level; before_sleep_log hooks into module logger; config values tuned to stay under stale_indexing_threshold_seconds
technical_risk.mitigation: tenacity is transitive dep already available via langchain; retry only on frozenset of safe status codes; reraise=True preserves original error; config-driven limits prevent unbounded waits

key_reasoning.reason: Change is contained within one class in one file: @retry decorator on _search_content_by_cql plus two module-level helpers in the same module. Tests and YAML config are support files, not separate components.

Three files modified: confluence_loader.py (retry logic), test_confluence_loader.py (TestSearchContentByCqlRetry class appended), datasources-config.yaml (indexing_max_retries reduced 10→2, indexing_error_retry_wait_max_seconds reduced 600→120 with explanatory comments). No files created.
